kind: validation-informed protocol amendment (made after the amendment-1 search, not before it)
stop_rule: This grid is final. If any arm selects 1e-2 (the new top edge), the edge is reported and the grid is not extended again. A run that diverges (non-finite predictions) is recorded as diverged and is never selectable.
reason: Under amendment 1, scratch selected 3e-3, the top of the shared grid (validation core macro AUROC 0.7603 / 0.7630 / 0.7640 / 0.7686 from 1e-4 to 3e-3). The central question is pretraining versus scratch, so the baseline must not be under-tuned; one inexpensive extra rate makes the comparison more defensible. Added for all three arms; selection rule unchanged (validation core macro AUROC at repeat 0, budget 0.10). No test data was examined.
unchanged: everything except the grid: core labels, budgets, repeats and seeds, subsets, encoder, pretraining, loss, optimiser, step budget, selection rule, AF threshold rule, evaluation plan

pretrain_r0.note: complete, base protocol; pretraining settings unchanged

lrsearch_a1_runs.note: the 12 runs at rates 1e-4..3e-3 are reused for the amendment-2 selection after a per-run compatibility check (run-relevant settings unchanged; they reproduced the pilot exactly). Only the 3 runs at 1e-2 are new.
